selection: building centroid within100m of non-crop source coast; supported non-landmark buildings

facades.imagery: authored procedural windows/doors/shutters/plaster, not facade photographs
facades.residentialEntrance: one authored entrance on nearest-source-road edge; no measured door position
facades.materialFinish: authored grain/rain/splash marks, varied glass reflection/curtains/shutters; existing geometry/UV/paint unchanged
facades.atlasChannels: sRGB colour, linear recessed height and material roughness; opaque shared RGBA8 atlas

balconies.placement: authored on seaward wall cells; neighbour/prior-prop/water checks
balconies.collision: conservative world AABB from actual part geometry transform; original building prism remains closed

surroundings.placement: source footprint outward bands intersect existing unpaved land; terrain triangle sampling

references.purpose: town roof silhouette, visual reference only

references.author: Zach1055
references.purpose: surroundings reference only, not a facade survey

limits: Approximately3x2km scope and source heights retained; no photogrammetry
No measured balconies/windows/storefronts or current business inventory
No new building interiors, traffic, water or flight dynamics

foundations.placement: selected source coastal footprints; skirt edges split at heightfield grid, diagonal and wall-base crossings
foundations.collision: additional tagged closed source-footprint prism down to minimum terrain beneath footprint; buried conservative volume
foundations.limits: only exposed gaps closed; uphill buried doors/facades from coarse DSM remain; unsupported geometry retains original prism
